name: One Signature Stage
applies_when: one memorable spatial moment is needed
recipe: Choose one dominant brand/world stage; keep surrounding sections calmer
implementation: Bounded canvas/media or stage with clear entry/exit

name: Bounded Immersive Rendering
applies_when: immersive rendering adds identity
recipe: Confine high-cost rendering to the section where it creates meaning
implementation: Lazy mount; pause offscreen; static fallback

name: Motion as Focus
applies_when: motion should direct editorial attention
recipe: Move the focal object/transition, not every surface
implementation: Assign one motion owner per section

name: Responsive Brand Payload
applies_when: brand expression must survive device changes
recipe: Preserve identity-bearing visual/type cue while simplifying mechanics
implementation: Separate brand payload from desktop geometry

name: Proof Before Fireworks
applies_when: agency credibility must precede spectacle
recipe: Show named work/outcomes/process before or alongside spectacle
implementation: Anchor theatrical sections to project proof

name: Editorial Case Story
applies_when: case studies need narrative rhythm
recipe: Large media + decisive text beats + process/outcome sequencing
implementation: Treat each case as authored editorial sequence

name: Editorial Type Contrast
applies_when: agency needs personality without harming utility
recipe: Expressive display role + quieter grotesk body role
avoid: Display type for all long copy
implementation: Limit expressive face to identity moments

name: Product Evidence Before Feature Claims
applies_when: technical audiences distrust vague marketing
recipe: Show code/product behavior early, then explain benefits
implementation: Use plausible code/UI/events before claims

name: Code as Product Proof
applies_when: API ergonomics are differentiation
recipe: Let code communicate naming, brevity, mental model
implementation: Use truthful syntax/API shapes

name: Developer Hero Split
applies_when: hero must balance identity and implementation confidence
recipe: Editorial headline paired with immediate product/code evidence
avoid: Generic SaaS hero with no technical signal
implementation: Keep CTA adjacent to implementation proof

name: Responsive Fidelity Substitution
applies_when: desktop technical proof is too wide on mobile
recipe: Replace wide proof with narrower truthful representation
implementation: Substitute mechanism, preserve claim

name: Dark Precision Shell
applies_when: dark developer product needs hierarchy
recipe: Near-black shell, crisp borders, sparse surfaces, strong type
implementation: Let content/code carry visual weight

name: Modular Product Proof
applies_when: many features need repeated evidence
recipe: Give each capability one fitting proof surface
avoid: Same dashboard mockup for every feature
implementation: Match proof format to feature semantics

name: Editorial + Technical Type Roles
applies_when: developer identity benefits from emotional + technical roles
recipe: Editorial display for brand; neutral/mono for product detail
implementation: Separate brand emotion from implementation readability

name: Aspect-Ratio Art Direction
applies_when: campaign artwork changes across viewport shapes
recipe: Select portrait/landscape/ultrawide crop or asset by aspect ratio
implementation: Author focal points and responsive media variants

name: World-Led Campaign Chapters
applies_when: campaign needs a journey through world/story
recipe: Assign one job to hero, trailer, story, world, exploration, news, outro
implementation: Sequence chapters as world reveal

name: Trailer as User-Invoked Proof
applies_when: video is strongest but expensive proof
recipe: Prominent user-invoked trailer with strong poster
avoid: Long autoplay video as sole proof
implementation: Poster first; load playback on intent

name: Back-of-Box Chapter
applies_when: campaign needs concise final summary
recipe: Compact premise/platform/date/action chapter near conversion
implementation: Summarize decision-critical info only

name: Media Cost Ladder
applies_when: cinematic pages need graduated media cost
recipe: Still -> light motion -> bounded video -> renderer only when earned
implementation: Escalate only when each tier improves story

name: Responsive World Payload
applies_when: mobile must retain world identity
recipe: Preserve logo/key art/one world cue; reduce layers/video cost
implementation: Define minimum world payload per breakpoint

name: Cinematic Chapter Contrast
applies_when: long campaign needs rhythm
recipe: Alternate full-bleed art, restrained copy, media, breathing space
implementation: Use chapter contrast to reset attention

name: Confidence as Interface
applies_when: data is uncertain/freshness-sensitive
recipe: Expose confidence, provenance, freshness, methodology near data
implementation: Attach evidence metadata to qualified values

name: Route-Family Density Ladder
applies_when: same dataset serves summary/browse/compare/detail
recipe: Use low/medium/high/one-record density by route job
implementation: Define information density per route family

name: Contain Horizontal Density, Don?t Crush It
applies_when: comparison tables cannot stay readable by shrinking
recipe: Allow internal horizontal overflow in bounded comparison surface
implementation: Own overflow at component boundary

name: Human + Machine Surface Parity
applies_when: technical directory exposes machine surfaces
recipe: Align sitemap/metadata/route names/caveats with UI
implementation: Cross-check sitemap, metadata, methodology

name: Methodology Adjacent to Data
applies_when: comparison claims need method context
recipe: Link methodology/confidence directly from compare/detail surfaces
implementation: Put short method cues near claims

name: Data Typography Roles
applies_when: dense reference UI needs semantic roles
recipe: Strong sans hierarchy + mono identifiers/measurements
implementation: Reserve mono for scan-critical data

name: One-Record Detail Surface
applies_when: users need deep evaluation of one item
recipe: Promote one record with evidence, caveats, alternatives
avoid: Detail page repeats directory row only
implementation: Expand context/update state/related comparison

name: Low-Motion Dense UI
applies_when: dense data work benefits from stability
recipe: Motion only for state/feedback; scanning surfaces stay still
implementation: Prefer short feedback to decorative choreography

name: Operational Pipeline Storytelling
applies_when: AI/orchestration value is causal workflow
recipe: Show engine/model -> context -> agent/workspace -> tools -> action/output
avoid: Abstract AI orb + generic benefit copy
implementation: Visualize stages and handoffs with truthful outputs

name: Proof Surface Cropping
applies_when: desktop UI proof is wider than mobile
recipe: Keep readable UI scale and crop inside bounded viewport
avoid: Scaling product screenshot until text is illegible
implementation: Crop/scroll proof internally while outer document stays stable

name: Credibility Through Route Ecosystem
applies_when: enterprise trust spans multiple concerns
recipe: Use integrations, pricing, company, content, legal/security, careers, contact/demo, FAQ as trust satellites
avoid: Stuffing every trust claim on home
implementation: Give each trust job a dedicated route family

name: Model Context Action Grammar
applies_when: AI product promise depends on context and execution
recipe: Explain engine/model + business context + action + observable result
implementation: Show where context comes from and what changes after action

name: Light Enterprise Calm
applies_when: enterprise AI needs confidence more than spectacle
recipe: Light neutral shell, disciplined spacing, clear product proof
implementation: Let operational evidence create sophistication

name: Trust Satellite Separation
applies_when: careers/legal/company/demo have different jobs
recipe: Keep commercial core concise while satellites answer specific trust questions
avoid: Duplicating full landing page into every route
implementation: Shared shell with route-specific density

name: Smooth Scroll Lifecycle Discipline
applies_when: smooth scrolling is used in long marketing pages
recipe: Coordinate smooth-scroll lifecycle with reduced motion and scroll locks
implementation: Stop/start engine around locks and preferences

name: Conversation-to-Action Proof
applies_when: AI agent differentiates by execution
recipe: intent/question -> contextual answer -> source/trust -> artifact/action -> next state
avoid: Chat bubble screenshot as end state
implementation: Show action and resulting operational state truthfully

name: Sticky Capability Stack
applies_when: capability chapters share stable proof shell
recipe: Use desktop sticky proof stage with chapter changes and sufficient scroll distance
avoid: Multiple unrelated sticky elements fighting for viewport
implementation: One sticky owner; release or simplify on narrow screens

name: Template Residue Quarantine
applies_when: template/demo routes contain residue
recipe: Include artifacts in coverage but exclude vendor/editor/placeholder identity from core DNA
avoid: Treating every routable artifact as product truth
implementation: Classify route role before promoting patterns

name: Agent SaaS Route Grammar
applies_when: agent product needs product + trust + content surfaces
recipe: Home/product proof + pricing + changelog + content + legal + conversion
implementation: Distribute trust and product learning across routes

name: Chat-to-Artifact Continuity
applies_when: agent should produce something inspectable
recipe: Keep question/context and generated artifact/action in one visual chain
avoid: Detached mockups with no causal link
implementation: Use one information model across question and output

name: Release Sticky Geometry on Mobile
applies_when: wide sticky proof stages become oppressive on mobile
recipe: Preserve narrative order but return panels to normal flow when needed
avoid: Forcing desktop sticky stage on narrow viewport
implementation: Decide sticky by reading job, not desktop parity

name: Muted Mono Utility Role
applies_when: technical labels need subtle differentiation
recipe: Use compact mono/utility role sparingly inside human SaaS typography
avoid: Turning whole site into terminal cosplay
implementation: Reserve utility role for labels/metadata

name: Reflective Case Study Arc
applies_when: portfolio needs credible process reflection
recipe: problem -> intervention -> result -> constraints/tradeoffs -> what changes next -> learning
implementation: Include decisions and limits, not just finals

name: Persistent Context Rail
applies_when: long case/editorial route needs orientation
recipe: Sticky local nav/metadata rail on wide screens; release for mobile reading
implementation: Keep rail contextual and secondary

name: Experimental Surface Isolation
applies_when: high-risk drag/cursor/collage interaction expresses personality
recipe: Isolate experimental interaction in bounded playground/route
avoid: Inject novelty into every case/contact page
implementation: Create a safe experimental zone with clear escape

name: Sticky Portfolio Stages
applies_when: project sequence benefits from staged attention
recipe: Pin/hold project media or identity while narrative changes
implementation: Use stickiness only for stage-like project chapters

name: Expressive Multi-Role Typography
applies_when: portfolio identity benefits from contrast
recipe: Bold display + mono + occasional handwritten accent with strict roles
avoid: Multiple novelty fonts in body copy
implementation: Assign every typeface one job

name: Drag Interaction Boundary
applies_when: drag surface is intentional play
recipe: Keep draggable objects inside viewport-locked playground and preserve normal controls
implementation: Separate play interaction from task interaction

name: Mobile Editorial Decompression
applies_when: desktop overlaps and sticky rails need simplification
recipe: Stack projects, reduce giant type, release rails, preserve one personality cue
implementation: Restore reading flow while keeping identity

name: Commercial Core + Trust Satellites
applies_when: focused B2B/service offering can live mostly on one commercial page
recipe: Keep benefits/features/services/process/proof/pricing/FAQ on core page; move contact/privacy/changelog to satellites
implementation: Split only where user job changes

name: Pricing-to-Comparison Bridge
applies_when: pricing needs defensible differentiation after plans
recipe: Place comparison/evidence directly after packages
avoid: Vague Us vs Others superiority table
implementation: Compare verifiable dimensions only

name: Numbered Service Process
applies_when: service buyers need engagement clarity
recipe: Short numbered process with outputs and decision points
implementation: Each step states action and deliverable

name: Ambient Media Boundaries
applies_when: video can add polish to light service site
recipe: Bound ambient media to hero/footer/signature zones
implementation: Limit media to zones with identity payoff

name: Light Service Shell
applies_when: service/agency AI site needs clarity
recipe: Light neutral canvas, restrained accent, generous rhythm, direct sections
implementation: Let service process/proof differentiate

name: Mobile Long-Form Expansion
applies_when: desktop horizontal sections become tall mobile flow
recipe: Stack content and accept taller document while preserving CTA order
implementation: Optimize reading order, not page length

name: Cinematic Without Heavy Rendering
applies_when: game/studio identity can be achieved without live 3D
recipe: Strong still art, authored crop, condensed type, HUD metadata, sticky sequencing, lightweight motion
implementation: Escalate renderer only when world state needs it

name: Capability-to-Case Pairing
applies_when: studio sells capabilities and must prove delivery
recipe: Service/capability routes answer what; case/project routes answer how/proof
avoid: Mixing service claims and fake cases into one card type
implementation: Cross-link capability to real project evidence

name: Game Studio Routing Boundary
applies_when: distinguish studio marketing from single-game launch
recipe: Studio/company as product -> game-studio; franchise launch -> cinematic launch
avoid: Using launch grammar for outsourcing site
implementation: Choose route grammar by what is marketed

name: Authored Still-Art Crop
applies_when: hero/project art carries world identity
recipe: Author desktop/mobile focal crop instead of generic cover center
implementation: Store focal point/variant metadata with art

name: Sticky Project Deck
applies_when: case/project cards can behave like cinematic chapters
recipe: Use full-stage sticky project cards when each remains readable
avoid: Tiny stacked cards pinned on mobile
implementation: Retain sticky only for complete readable stages

name: HUD Metadata Restraint
applies_when: game visual language benefits from instrumentation cues
recipe: Use brackets/ticks/mono labels as secondary metadata
implementation: Hierarchy: art/title/action first, HUD second

name: Job-Based Sticky Decision
applies_when: some sticky systems survive mobile and others should not
recipe: Keep sticky if it remains a readable story stage; release if it blocks long-form reading
implementation: Evaluate sticky by user job and occupancy

name: Prompt-to-Experience Compile Contract
applies_when: ambitious prompt names beats but not architecture
recipe: Compile narrative beats, world mechanics, input roles, payoff, performance, fallback before coding
avoid: Literal effect pile from prompt nouns
implementation: Create explicit state/config contract first

name: Narrative Parameter Matrix
applies_when: multiple subsystems must express one story state
recipe: Per chapter coordinate copy, palette, world state, camera, FX, HUD, audio
implementation: Use one authored state object/matrix

name: Event Peaks on Continuous Timeline
applies_when: continuous scrollytelling needs punctuation
recipe: Keep most state reversible/continuous; reserve sparse ignition/impact/explosion/reveal events
implementation: Trigger peaks from same progress domain

name: Weighted Narrative Timeline
applies_when: story beats deserve unequal dwell
recipe: Assign chapter weights -> normalized bounds -> local progress -> hold/transform windows
implementation: Tune dwell by narrative importance/readability

name: Shared Progress Bus
applies_when: renderer, DOM, HUD and audio must stay synchronized
recipe: One authoritative progress drives world, camera, text, nav, FX and audio
avoid: Separate scroll listeners for each subsystem
implementation: Expose one story progress plus secondary velocity

name: One World, Analytic States
applies_when: many chapters share a procedural physical basis
recipe: Reuse one structural world basis and synthesize stages analytically
implementation: Use shared buffers/attributes + stage uniforms

name: Two-Layer Renderer
applies_when: atmosphere and semantic foreground have different costs
recipe: Separate cheap fullscreen atmosphere from foreground world
avoid: One heavy geometry system for all layers
implementation: Assign atmosphere and semantic geometry to distinct layers

name: Adaptive Renderer Budget
applies_when: GPU quality must degrade without losing story
recipe: Cap DPR/detail then adapt DPR/effect quality at runtime
avoid: Fixed max quality on every device
implementation: Reduce resolution/particles/FX before semantic content

name: Procedural Score as State Layer
applies_when: sound materially reinforces narrative
recipe: Opt-in audio bed with chapter mix targets and sparse semantic cues
implementation: Keep silence path and mute control

name: Payoff First, Coda Second
applies_when: final emotional frame needs isolation
recipe: Land payoff first, reveal replay/explanation later
implementation: Delay utility UI until after payoff dwell

name: Integration Detail as Implementation Proof
applies_when: integration claim needs more than logo availability
recipe: identity/job -> capabilities -> installation -> setup metadata -> action -> fallback -> related integrations
avoid: Logo wall as sole integration proof
implementation: Use connector-specific instructions and operational metadata

name: Route-Family Binding Integrity
applies_when: dynamic routes can bind wrong CMS records
recipe: Verify slug/canonical/title/H1/summary/media/metadata/body/metrics/CTA resolve to same record
implementation: Scan complete family and compare server/hydrated identity

name: Operational Micro-Scenes
applies_when: automation benefits are easier as short workflows
recipe: Show task chains, statuses, handoffs and outputs
implementation: Use realistic micro UI with clear causality

name: Taxonomy-Led Integration Discovery
applies_when: large integration catalog needs task/category navigation
recipe: Group by telephony/payment/CRM/automation/analytics before detail
implementation: Make categories reflect user jobs

name: Duplicate-Content Canary
applies_when: CMS/template residue can silently spread
recipe: Normalize hero/body across family and flag unexpected near-duplicates
avoid: Assuming unique slugs imply unique content
implementation: Automate similarity/identity checks

name: Desktop Media -> Mobile Semantic Substitute
applies_when: desktop video/canvas can overwhelm mobile
recipe: Remove/reduce media while keeping claim/proof/order
avoid: Keeping all desktop media at mobile cost
implementation: Substitute lighter still/UI/text proof

name: Commercial Core + Proof Satellites
applies_when: large SaaS ecosystem has product/integration/case/content/legal jobs
recipe: Dense home + focused pricing/integration/case/blog/contact/legal routes
implementation: Give each family its own density/proof role

name: Full-Family QA Before Launch
applies_when: template CMS leaves copy/copy-copy routes and placeholders
recipe: Inventory every public route; quarantine/delete residue; validate legal variables
implementation: Treat sitemap/search index as release checklist

name: World Metaphor as Information Architecture
applies_when: a portfolio or creative catalog benefits from one memorable world vocabulary
recipe: map each world term to one stable real content job across navigation, index, detail, CTA and utility routes
avoid: invented lore that renames ordinary pages without improving memory or navigation
implementation: write world term -> real job -> visible cue -> conventional/accessibility fallback before styling

name: Taxonomy as Visual Physics
applies_when: stable categories should be recognizable across collection, detail, map and related content
recipe: let category identity control bounded variables such as accent, badge, illustration family, local tint and map position
implementation: keep semantic category names visible and lock category-to-visual mapping site-wide

name: Mnemonic Case-Study Encoding
applies_when: portfolio projects need stronger recall without losing professional evidence
recipe: combine mnemonic name/object/creature + optional number + category with client, year, scope, brief, intervention and result
avoid: cute project names replacing actual client/work/outcome
implementation: layer mnemonic identity on top of conventional searchable case-study metadata

name: Metaphor Translation Contract
applies_when: navigation, services or CTAs use playful/diegetic language
recipe: for every world term define the real job, visible cue and accessible/conventional fallback
avoid: requiring first-time visitors to learn lore before acting
implementation: verify URLs, headings, subtitles, metadata, form labels and accessible names expose the real task

name: Project Evolution as Relationship Proof
applies_when: a later engagement genuinely grows from earlier work for the same client/product
recipe: original engagement -> changed need -> expanded problem -> evolved system -> new observable outcome
implementation: cross-link related case entries and state what was retained, expanded and measured

name: Illustrated Worldbuilding Without Heavy Rendering
applies_when: a playful world needs identity but continuous 3D would add cost without user value
recipe: use illustration, naming, collection grammar, category color, DOM motion and map/quest metaphors to create world continuity
avoid: adding WebGL merely because the experience feels game-adjacent
implementation: prefer DOM/Framer/CSS choreography and static illustrated final states with reduced-motion support

name: Service Packaging as Quests
applies_when: a creative service business has a few productized engagements with clear scope
recipe: themed service identity + plain outcome + price/range + duration + deliverables + conventional CTA
avoid: quest naming that hides what is sold or how long/costly it is
implementation: keep playful title while exposing commercial details above the fold on detail routes

name: Collection Completion Loop
applies_when: a small portfolio/catalog benefits from visitors wanting to browse the complete set
recipe: number or type records, expose related entries and a collection index, and make collection coverage legible
avoid: fake gamification that pressures users or blocks free navigation
implementation: make every entry independently useful and let the collection layer encourage rather than require completion

name: One-Page Studio Conversion Spine
applies_when: a compact studio has enough proof for one persuasive route but not deep route families
recipe: identity -> credibility -> capabilities -> game proof -> world art -> testimonials -> FAQ -> team -> contact -> final trust
avoid: forcing one page when service/case SEO or deep proof needs dedicated routes
implementation: anchor navigation + clear section jobs + one conversion spine

name: Sticky Game Selector
applies_when: a small project/game set benefits from stable comparison navigation
recipe: sticky selector rail + one stable proof region + meaningful selected game state
avoid: focusable DIV pseudo-tabs without role/state semantics
implementation: buttons/tabs; explicit selected state; keyboard behavior; release sticky on narrow screens

name: Poster-First Media Interlude
applies_when: a visual reset benefits from video but motion is not required for comprehension
recipe: authored poster/still first -> deferred video bytes -> optional explicit playback
implementation: preload none; poster retains meaning; visible play/pause/mute if playback matters

name: Proof -> Objection -> People -> Contact
applies_when: service buyers need social proof, objection handling and team confidence before lead capture
recipe: testimonials -> FAQ -> team -> contact form
implementation: make every proof item truthful; semantic accordion; real form submission

name: Anchor-Driven Commercial Core
applies_when: one long route contains distinct commercial jobs
recipe: header anchors map directly to about, services, games and contact; secondary anchors expose FAQ/team/testimonials
avoid: anchor labels that do not map to clear user jobs
implementation: stable IDs; scroll-margin for fixed header; current-section feedback only when useful

name: Template Residue Firewall
applies_when: a template is visually coherent but may contain stale identity/content bindings
recipe: verify one identity across hero, metrics, projects, FAQ, team, contact, forms, footer, meta/OG and 404
avoid: assuming visual consistency implies content consistency
implementation: release-time invariant sweep + link/form destination audit
